config.kuvalich.enableDetailedLogging.to:
Enable to log all detailed information
Includes: damage calculations, attribute values,
decryption progress, kill stacks, item confiscation
§c⚠ Warning: Generates massive log output!§r
§cOnly enable for debugging!§r
config.kuvalich.confiscationChance.toolt:
Chance of item being confiscated after decrypting riddle
§71.0§r = 1%% chance (default)
§710.0§r = 10%% chance
§70.0§r = Disable confiscation system
Confiscated items drop when Lich is killed

§725.0§r = 25%% chance (default)
